description:
FILED s539a (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-13) from #4167.

Since s539a lib/Encode.pm no longer ADVERTISES an encoding the host cannot decode: resolve_alias and find_encoding both answer undef for these names (rule 12; before, resolve_alias answered perl's canonical name and find_encoding undef -- Pod-Simple JustPod_corpus.t read the advertised name and died at decode).  cp932 WAS wired in the same batch (SBCL has :cp932; its whole double-byte repertoire matches perl's: 9795 of 11471 sequences decodable, the same 398 one-way).

MEASURED (s539a, perl 5.40.3 / Encode on this box) -- what is missing, by perl's own tables:
  family  perl .so size   names                         BMP chars encodable (perl)
  TW      2,157,280 B     big5-eten / big5-hkscs / cp950  13,897 / 18,340 / 20,192
  KR      2,559,600 B     euc-kr / cp949 / johab          8,226 / 17,632 / 17,048 (+ iso-2022-kr over euc-kr)
  CN      2,225,688 B     euc-cn (gb2312) / hz            7,445 / 7,445 (+ iso-ir-165, gb12345-raw)
  JP      2,872,192 B     iso-2022-jp / 7bit-jis          13,008 (stateful over jis0208; euc-jp / shiftjis / cp932 ARE wired)
SBCL 2.6.0's external formats have none of them (sb-impl::*external-formats*; measured with sb-int:get-external-format).

THE OPTIONS (none chosen): (a) generate each table from perl's own Encode (decode every 2-byte sequence, as tools/rebuild-uniprops does for Unicode properties) into a checked-in data artifact read by a table-driven codec in the runtime -- ~8k-20k pairs per codec; (b) libiconv through sb-alien (the zlib precedent, #3161) -- portability cost; (c) leave them out (today's state, now honest).  A program that names one gets perl's `Unknown encoding 'big5'` from encode/decode and undef from both name lookups.

docs/not-supported.md "Encode: encodings with no codec" is the user-facing entry.
subject: Encode: the CJK codecs SBCL has no external format for (big5-eten / big5-hkscs / cp950, euc-kr / cp949 / johab / iso-2022-kr, euc-cn / hz, iso-2022-jp / 7bit-jis) cannot be decoded -- the tables to ship, sized
